sources.entry: ChargeMonitor - Menu bar battery monitor with real-time charging stats and energy impact insights. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/CrashSystemZ/ChargeMonitor)

summary.one_liner: ChargeMonitor is a lightweight macOS menu bar utility that shows battery percentage and a popover with real-time charging stats and apps with significant energy impact.
use_cases: Check battery percentage from the menu bar
See charging speed and adapter details
Find which apps are draining the battery
how_to_run: Or download the latest release from GitHub
Launch ChargeMonitor and click the menu bar item to open the popover
notable: Heuristic 'Using Significant Energy' view using CPU time, wakeups, and disk activity with EMA thresholds
Reads system power sources and the smart battery interface for charging and cycle data
Runs as an accessory app with no Dock icon and no extra permissions
Sends no data to external servers; update checks only query the GitHub Releases API
caveats: Time to full is shown only while charging and only when the system provides it
The significant energy view is a heuristic, not a precise replica of system telemetry
